question: Where can the yogi realize fullness amid all states of activity?
premises: Wherever union with bliss arises, there the own nature is full.
If the delusion of difference is known, one may reach peace there.
Even in waking and all states, the yogi can become lord of the great wheel of consciousness while active.
inference: Recognizing bliss and dispelling the delusion of difference allows the yogi to realize fullness in every state.
uncertainties: The two '---' tokens mark a lacuna in the transmitted text.
The fragmentary sequence 'te veti' is preserved as given and may be textually uncertain.
plain_english: Wherever union with bliss arises, there one's own nature is full; if the delusion of difference is understood, one may reach peace there. Even in waking and in every state, the yogi can become the lord of the great wheel of consciousness, moving through varied activities while shining with mantra power.
